Basic reranking of documents against a query

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:liter_llm/liter_llm.dart';
import 'package:liter_llm/src/liter_llm_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final request = await createRerankRequestFromJson(json: '{"documents":["Machine learning is a subset of AI.","The weather is sunny today.","Deep learning uses neural networks."],"model":"rerank-v3.5","query":"What is machine learning?"}');
    final apiKey = Platform.environment['API_KEY'];
      if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty) { throw StateError('API_KEY must be set'); }
      final client = await LiterLlmBridge.createClient(apiKey);
    final result = await client.rerank(req: request);
    stdout.writeln(result.results);
    stdout.writeln(result.results[0].relevanceScore);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
